description: This source file implements RBUS data model provider handlers for TR-069 host interface, including get/set handlers, event subscription, and RBUS initialization. It manages parameter registration, data type conversions, and communication with RBUS framework.

methods.name: convert2hostIfDataType
methods.description: Converts string data type to HostIf_ParamType_t enum.

methods.name: TR_Dml_EventSubHandler
methods.description: Handles RBUS event subscription and manages auto-publish logic.

methods.name: TR_Dml_GetHandler
methods.description: Handles RBUS get requests, retrieves parameter values from data model or defaults.

methods.name: TR_Dml_SetHandler
methods.description: Handles RBUS set requests, updates parameters in data model.

methods.name: init_rbus_dml_provider
methods.description: Initializes RBUS, registers data elements, and sets up parameter list.

methods.name: setRbusStringParam
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value in RBUS.

methods.name: getRbusStringParam
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value from RBUS.
